name: The outer austerities (bāhya-tapas) — summary only
method_summary: TS 9.19 names the outer austerities, which include forms of fasting and bodily mortification. Restricted topic: only the topic is recorded, with no forms, amounts or durations. The sūtra states no purpose here beyond that of tapas in 9.3, shedding of karma.
